main_body: Large leaf canopy made of seven or eight rounded clumps, on a brown trunk with a root flare
top_band: No single flat top band. Each canopy clump has a lighter green top (e.g. x=29 rows 12-13, L=142) over darker green lower rows (L 55-85). The lit top reads as a rounded volume.
evidence: The canopy is a rounded organic mass lit from above, with highlighted clump tops and dark undersides that shade the lower rows. It is not a flat elevation, and a plant canopy needs no rectangular top slab. The trunk is a plain front view with a root flare, which is normal for a tree. Accepted as 3/4 because the object is organic; the lack of a distinct top band is the weak point.

style.evidence: The ramp has about 6 greens (L 142, 110, 85, 64, 46, 31) and the outline is a tinted dark green, with no flat 5x5 areas. The measured facts are far below both references. The candidate has only 15 distinct colours against 427 and 567, and a median of 7 colours per tile against 108 and 109. The clumps are blocky and repetitive, with little per-leaf variation, so the tree looks thinner and flatter than the Beodeul references.
